title: packet_range: Get the number of packets chosen
description:
Add a method to return the number of packets in the range
according to the currently selected parameters (all vs filtered,
include dependents, include ignored.)

Use that in the Print header line instead of always printing the
number of filtered/displayed packets, so that the "N shown" is
an accurate number.

Related to #16204
